events.title: Smart India Hackathon 2026 Grand Finale
events.description: National-level 36-hour non-stop digital product development competition aimed at solving real-world challenges faced by ministries and industrial sectors.
events.eligibilityCriteria: Undergraduate engineering teams of 6 with at least one female teammate. Minimum 75% institutional attendance required.
events.requiredDocuments: Team Shortlisting Letter, Hackathon ID Card, College Endorsement Form
events.purposeAndBenefits: Opportunity to represent the institution at national level, cash prizes up to INR 1,00,000, and institutional project incubator support.
events.studentInstructions: Submit official college OD application and collect travel authorization pass upon institutional in-charge signoff.

events.title: ACM ICPC Asia Regional Contest 2026
events.organizer: International Collegiate Programming Contest & Amrita University
events.description: Premier collegiate competitive programming contest globally. Teams of three solve complex algorithmic problems within a stringent 5-hour time window.
events.eligibilityCriteria: Valid ACM student chapter membership, preliminary round qualifiers, minimum 75% attendance.
events.requiredDocuments: Preliminary Round Rank Certificate, Team Registration Confirmation Slip
events.purposeAndBenefits: Direct opportunity to qualify for the ICPC World Finals. Elite technology recruiters recruitment benchmark.
events.studentInstructions: Attach official preliminary scorecard in supporting documents when submitting your institutional permission request.

events.title: IEEE International Conference on Advanced Robotics & AI
events.description: Peer-reviewed international research symposium presenting recent innovations in autonomous unmanned vehicles, humanoid kinematics, and perception networks.
events.eligibilityCriteria: Accepted full paper or poster presentation, co-author recommendation, institutional attendance compliance.
events.requiredDocuments: Peer Review Acceptance Letter, IEEE Paper Copy (PDF), Author Registration Receipt
events.purposeAndBenefits: Paper publication in IEEE Xplore digital library (Scopus indexed) and research networking with robotics labs.
events.studentInstructions: Institutional research sponsorship reimbursed up to 50% for sanctioned paper presenters.

events.title: Google Developer Student Clubs India Summit 2026
events.description: National developer leadership summit featuring hands-on deep dives in Gemini 2.0 API, Flutter multiplatform, and Cloud Run production architectures.
events.eligibilityCriteria: GDSC Core Team members or active campus contributors. 75% attendance threshold applies.
events.requiredDocuments: GDSC Lead Invitation Email, Developer Profile URL
events.purposeAndBenefits: Direct mentorship from Google Developer Experts, early access developer tooling, and community leadership credits.
events.studentInstructions: Bring personal laptop and official college ID card. Mentor endorsement required.

events.title: DRDO & ISRO Propulsion Lab Industrial Study Visit
events.description: Technical site visit to cryogenic test stands, composite airframe fabrication bays, and high-altitude simulation chambers.
events.eligibilityCriteria: Mechanical, ECE, or Aerospace engineering students with no active disciplinary flags.
events.requiredDocuments: Security Clearance Undertaking Form, Institutional ID, Aadhaar Card Copy
events.purposeAndBenefits: Hands-on observation of cryogenic launch vehicle engines and propellant handling infrastructure.
events.studentInstructions: Mobile phones and electronic recording devices strictly restricted inside propulsion bays.

events.title: National Cybersecurity Capture The Flag (CTF) Challenge
events.description: Jeopardy-style offensive and defensive cybersecurity contest covering binary exploitation, cryptography, reverse engineering, and web vulnerabilities.
events.venue: Virtual Online Platform & Finals at CERT-In HQ
events.eligibilityCriteria: Open to all undergraduate CS/IT students. Teams of 2-4.
events.requiredDocuments: CTF Player Handle Profile, College Enrollment Letter
events.purposeAndBenefits: Opportunity for national ranking on CTFtime, fellowship opportunities with Indian cyber defense units.
events.studentInstructions: Ensure reliable high-speed internet connectivity. VPN access details will be distributed 2 hours prior.
